name: get_plain_in_main
args: NR == 1 { r = getline; print r, $0, NR, FNR }

name: get_plain_at_eof
args: END { r = getline; print r, $0 }

name: get_plain_in_begin_consumes
args: BEGIN { while ((getline) > 0) n++; print n, NR }

name: get_var_form
args: { r = getline x; print r, x, $0, NR }

name: get_var_form_fields_untouched
args: { getline x; print NF, $1 }

name: get_file_form
args: BEGIN { while ((getline < "f") > 0) print "got", $0, NR }
stdout:
got l1 0
got l2 0
got l3 0

name: get_file_var_form
args: BEGIN { while ((getline line < "f") > 0) print "got", line, NR }
stdout:
got l1 0
got l2 0
got l3 0

name: get_file_form_sets_nf
args: BEGIN { getline < "f"; print NF, $0 }

name: get_file_missing
args: BEGIN { r = getline x < "nonexist"; print r }

name: get_file_missing_loop_ends
args: BEGIN { while ((getline x < "nonexist") > 0) n++; print n + 0 }

name: get_file_directory
args: BEGIN { r = getline x < "."; print r }

name: get_file_second_read_continues
args: BEGIN { getline a < "f"; getline b < "f"; print a, b }

name: get_file_close_rereads
args: BEGIN { getline a < "f"; close("f"); getline b < "f"; print a, b }

name: get_file_eof_then_minus
args: BEGIN { while ((getline x < "f") > 0); print (getline x < "f") }

name: get_file_no_trailing_newline
args: BEGIN { getline x < "f"; getline y < "f"; print x "|" y }

name: get_file_uses_rs
args: BEGIN { RS = ";"; while ((getline x < "f") > 0) print "[" x "]" }

name: get_file_does_not_touch_nr
args: BEGIN { getline x < "f"; print NR, FNR }

name: get_file_stdin_dash
args: BEGIN { getline x < "-"; print "[" x "]" }

name: get_file_dev_stdin
args: BEGIN { getline x < "/dev/stdin"; print "[" x "]" }

name: get_cmd_form
args: BEGIN { "echo hi there" | getline; print $2, NF, NR }

name: get_cmd_var_form
args: BEGIN { "echo hi there" | getline x; print x, NR }

name: get_cmd_loop
args:
BEGIN { while (("printf 'a
b
c
'" | getline x) > 0) print "got", x }
stdout:
got a
got b
got c

name: get_cmd_status_zero_at_eof
args: BEGIN { "true" | getline x; print ("true" | getline y) }

name: get_cmd_close_rerun
args: BEGIN { "echo one" | getline a; close("echo one"); "echo one" | getline b; print a, b }

name: get_cmd_no_close_no_rerun
args: BEGIN { "echo one" | getline a; r = ("echo one" | getline b); print a, r, "[" b "]" }

name: get_cmd_concatenated
args: BEGIN { x = "echo"; x " abc" | getline y; print y }

name: get_cmd_getline_compare
args: BEGIN { while ("echo a" | getline > 0) print "got" }

name: get_cmd_stderr_passthrough
args: BEGIN { "echo err 1>&2; echo out" | getline x; print x }

name: get_cmd_fails
args: BEGIN { r = ("exit 3" | getline x); print r; print close("exit 3") }

name: get_cmd_with_main_input
args: { "echo " $1 | getline x; print x }

name: get_cmd_nr_increments
args: { "echo z" | getline x; print NR }

name: get_assign_arr_elem
args: BEGIN { "echo q" | getline a["k"]; print a["k"] }

name: get_assign_field
args: BEGIN { $0 = "a b c"; "echo Z" | getline $2; print; print NF }

name: get_precedence_concat
args: BEGIN { "echo " "a" | getline x; print x }

name: get_in_condition_loop_file
args: BEGIN { f = "f"; while ((getline l < f) > 0) s = s l; print s }

name: get_unparenthesized_file_concat
args: BEGIN { getline l < "f" ".x"; print l }

name: get_getline_returns_one
args: BEGIN { print getline < "f" }

name: get_getline_var_numeric_string
args: BEGIN { getline x < "f"; print (x == 10), (x < 9) }

name: get_getline_field_numeric_string
args: BEGIN { getline < "f"; print ($1 == 1.0) }

name: get_bare_getline_updates_nf
args: NR==1 { getline; print NF }

name: get_getline_file_path_expression
args: BEGIN { d = "."; while ((getline l < (d "/f")) > 0) print l }
